name: dispatch-board
title: Dispatch board
subtitle: Fuel Distribution for Claude Code: who runs dry, what is on the trucks, what needs a decision

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Everything on the attention list, worst first.
sections.sql: select case reason when 'runout' then '1 Runs dry soon' when 'certificate_expired' then '2 Tank certificate lapsed' when 'driver_dg_expired' then '3 Driver endorsement lapsed' when 'truck_expired' then '4 Tanker certificate lapsed' when 'water' then '5 Water in the tank' when 'order_late' then '6 Order late' when 'variance' then '7 Stock lost on a run' when 'debtor' then '8 Account' when 'dip_stale' then '9 Not dipped' else '10 No price today' end as what, label as record, detail from v_attention order by 1, days

sections.title: Tanks at reorder within seven days
sections.note: Estimated level from the last dip, deliveries since and the measured daily use.
sections.sql: select customer, site, tank_no as tank, product, est_l as about_litres, use_per_day as litres_a_day, days_to_reorder, days_to_empty, room_l as room, case when on_order then 'on order' else '' end as ordered from v_runout where days_to_reorder <= 7 or days_to_empty is null order by days_to_empty nulls first

sections.title: Runs today and ahead
sections.sql: select r.ref as run, r.run_on as date, tr.rego as tanker, d.name as driver, tm.name as terminal, r.status, (select count(*) from orders o where o.run_id = r.id and o.status = 'planned') as drops_to_go, (select coalesce(sum(planned_litres), 0) from orders o where o.run_id = r.id and o.status = 'planned') as litres_to_go from runs r join trucks tr on tr.id = r.truck_id join drivers d on d.id = r.driver_id join terminals tm on tm.id = r.terminal_id where r.run_on >= current_date and r.status <> 'cancelled' order by r.run_on, r.ref

sections.title: Open orders
sections.sql: select o.ref as order_ref, c.name as customer, s.name as site, t.tank_no as tank, p.code as product, coalesce(o.litres_requested::text, 'fill') as litres, o.required_on as required, o.status, case when o.required_on < current_date then 'LATE' else '' end as late from orders o join tanks t on t.id = o.tank_id join sites s on s.id = t.site_id join customers c on c.id = s.customer_id join products p on p.id = t.product_id where o.status in ('open', 'planned') order by o.required_on

name: stock-and-money
title: Stock and money
subtitle: Fuel Distribution for Claude Code: what left the terminal against what reached a tank, margin, and who owes what

sections.title: Loaded against delivered, last 30 days, by tanker
sections.note: House limit: 0.5 per cent per run and product.
sections.sql: select rego as tanker, product, count(*) as runs, sum(loaded_l) as loaded, sum(delivered_l) as delivered, sum(variance_l) as lost, round(100.0 * sum(variance_l) / nullif(sum(loaded_l), 0), 3) as lost_pct from v_reconcile where status = 'completed' and run_on > current_date - 30 group by rego, product order by rego, product

sections.title: Margin by customer, last 30 days
sections.sql: select customer, count(*) as drops, sum(litres) as litres, round(avg(litres)) as average_drop, round(sum(margin) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(litres), 0), 2) as margin_cents_a_litre, sum(margin) as margin, round(sum(margin) / count(*), 2) as margin_per_drop from v_deliveries where delivered_on > current_date - 30 group by customer order by margin_per_drop

sections.title: Who owes what (ex GST)
sections.sql: select customer, owed_ex_gst as owed, overdue_ex_gst as overdue, over_30_ex_gst as over_30_days, oldest_overdue_days, credit_limit, case when credit_limit is not null and owed_ex_gst > credit_limit then 'OVER' else '' end as over_limit from v_debtors where owed_ex_gst > 0 order by overdue_ex_gst desc
